thread:
Ravi: Quick idea  can we capture concise 'cardlets' from post-onboard notes? Goal = 5 triage-ready items/day. Use the tiny template below and paste into the sheet: https://sheet.link/cardlets

Template:
Customer: [name]
Pain (1 line):
Ask (1 line):
Impact (1 line): ops/renewal/revenue/time saved
Priority: P0/P1/P2
Source + date:
Attachments: link(s) or short repro
Owner: CS/PM/Eng

June: Love it. I'll drop 3 from last week's handoffs. Quick question: should we auto-tag billing or embedding issues?

Asha (PM): Yes  auto-tag billing/embeds if those words appear in the note. Mark anything mentioning "churn" or "renewal" as [RENEWAL-RISK] and put an estimated revenue bucket if known.

Marco: Practical note: if there's a UX repro, include exact steps or a 30s Loom. PMs won't triage otherwise.

June: Pasting first card:
June: Card -> Customer: Solstice Media | Pain: search relevance drops for long descriptions (>3k chars) | Ask: improve retrieval scoring or allow custom scorer | Impact: editors manually rework content; potential renewal mention | Priority: P1 [RENEWAL-RISK] | Source: onboarding notes 6/2 | Attachments: sample queries.csv | Owner: Eng - NLP

Ravi: Nice. I added an enablement card too: "How to ask about billing exports" so CS has a script. Label as ENABL in the sheet.

CS Bot: Draft saved to sheet https://sheet.link/cardlets. Auto-extract inserted tags: billing, embed. Please review drafts and add card id when linking tickets.

Asha (PM): We'll review top 10 cards in Friday triage. P0s get immediate sprint consideration; P1s go to candidate list. If unsure, mark P2 and tag me.

Marco: One more: for billing asks, include a CSV example of desired columns. Saves 1-2 back-and-forths.

Ravi: Great. Closing loop  add by Thu EOD for this batch. Thanks team :thumbsup:
